kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أنثقب (form VII)
# أَنْثَقِبُ (ʔanṯaqibu) /ʔan.θa.qi.bu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْثَقَبَ (inṯaqaba)
# أَنْثَقِبَ (ʔanṯaqiba) /ʔan.θa.qi.ba/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْثَقَبَ (inṯaqaba)
# أَنْثَقِبْ (ʔanṯaqib) /ʔan.θa.qib/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْثَقَبَ (inṯaqaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
